newsitem.title: USA: U.S. cotton weekly export sales highlights--USDA.
newsitem.headline: U.S. cotton weekly export sales highlights--USDA.

text.p: USDA cotton export sales highlights in latest reporting week:
Net Upland sales of 238,300 running bales (RB) were three times the previous week and two and three-tenths times the 4-week average.
The major increases were for China (68,600 RB, includes 62,300 new sales, 7,000 destination changes), South Korea (36,400 RB), Turkey (26,300 RB), Mexico (26,000 RB), and Indonesia (18,600 RB).

Exports of 187,200 RB--a marketing-year high--exceeded the prior week by 7 percent and the 4-week average by 27 percent. Asian destinations accounted for 81 percent of the week's shipments; Western Hemisphere, 13 percent; and West European, 6 percent.
